description: One row of the case-study list: a specific game presented as a plausibly-small-scope, commercially-notable example within its archetype.
signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CaseStudy:
    appid: int
    name: str
    developer: str
    release_date: str
    price_usd: float
    review_count: int
    review_positive_pct: float
    estimated_sales_band: tuple[float, float, float]
    estimated_revenue_net_usd: float
    complexity_score: float
    top_tags: list[str]
    archetype_label: str
    rationale: str
    complexity_drivers: list[tuple[str, float]]
    store_url: str
docstring:
One case-study entry.

Attributes:
    estimated_sales_band: (low, mid, high) from games_enriched.
    estimated_revenue_net_usd: May be NaN for a free-to-play case study; the UI must render NaN as an explicit 'unknown' marker per reporting's own invariant, never as $0.
    complexity_score: The game's own score, in [0, 1].
    top_tags: Top few tags by vote, from game_tags.
    archetype_label: cluster_tags' label for this game's assigned cluster.
    rationale: build_rationale's output for this row.
    complexity_drivers: enrichment.compute_complexity_score's per-feature contributions for this row, top few by magnitude, e.g. [('install_size', 0.15), ('achievement_count', 0.08)], powering an explainability breakdown in the UI.
    store_url: Constructed as f'https://store.steampowered.com/app/{appid}/' -- a display convenience, not a fetched value.
postconditions: estimated_sales_band is non-decreasing: band[0] <= band[1] <= band[2]
rationale never asserts an unhedged development-time or cost claim (verified against a forbidden-phrase list by reporting's own tests, per the module's own testing requirement)

edge_cases.expected_behavior: estimated_revenue_net_usd is NaN (or None as constructed); the UI layer, not this dataclass, is responsible for rendering the unavailable marker, but the dataclass itself must not coerce NaN to 0.0 at construction time

edge_cases.input: A game with fewer than 3 retained tags
edge_cases.expected_behavior: top_tags has fewer than 3 entries rather than being padded with placeholders

unit_tests.name: test_sales_band_ordering
unit_tests.description: A constructed CaseStudy from fixture data has band[0] <= band[1] <= band[2].

unit_tests.name: test_free_to_play_revenue_not_coerced_to_zero
unit_tests.description: A F2P fixture case study has estimated_revenue_net_usd as NaN/None, not 0.0.
